subject: TrustCenter onboarding / SOW draft, pricing and evidence timeline
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidation ask: TrustCenter via SecureTrust + SOW starter

Hi team,

Following the platform review last week, execs want a single vendor path for Trust Center / compliance portal coverage rather than running parallel Drata and Vanta pilots. SecureTrust (our reseller) recommended TrustCenter as the fastest path to SSO + evidence hosting that maps to our current controls.

Can Monica please draft a short SOW we can send to the partner (scope: onboarding, mapping current SOC2 evidence, 3-month support)? Include milestone-based deliverables (kickoff, evidence ingest, control verification, account handoff). Markus — can you add the expected infra access checklist (service account, read-only S3 buckets, STS role)?

I want to get a vendor timeline and pricing window by EOD Friday so we can include this in the July ops review.

Thanks,
Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Head of Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Greene <alex.greene@trustcenter.com>, partners@securetrust.com
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Consolidation ask: TrustCenter via SecureTrust + SOW starter

Hi Alex / SecureTrust team — forwarding our internal ask and an initial SOW draft attached. High level: we want TrustCenter to ingest our existing SOC2 evidence, provide automated monitoring for key infra controls, and deliver a customer-facing compliance page.

Questions for you:
- Estimated onboarding timeline for a mid-sized infra footprint with 5 services and an existing SSO (Okta).
- Pricing bands for 12-month vs 24-month commitments (include onboarding fee).
- Which evidence formats you accept (S3 CSV, PDF exports from internal tools, manual uploads).

Attachment: trustcenter-sow-draft.docx (draft SOW, 2 pages)

Diego — draft attached. Markus, I added a short infra access list into section 2.

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Greene <alex.greene@trustcenter.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@securetrust.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Consolidation ask: TrustCenter via SecureTrust + SOW starter

Thanks Monica — appreciate the draft. Quick answers up front:
- Typical onboarding for this scope: 4–6 weeks (kickoff, evidence mapping, automated connectors into S3/OKTA, control tuning).
- Pricing: onboarding fee $6k (one-time) + platform seats: $3k/month (12-mo) or $2.4k/month (24-mo) for our standard bundle (includes evidence storage and monitoring). Enterprise tier available for custom SLAs.
- Evidence formats: we accept CSV exports, PDF, raw logs (S3), and SAML metadata for SSO. We can also ingest exported reports from current vendors.

We reviewed your SOW draft and have two quick asks: 1) We need a sample evidence matrix (formats + owner mapping) before kickoff — can you provide an initial sheet? 2) For SOC2 scoping, do you already have a controls mapping document (which policies map to which control IDs)?

Attaching an onboarding checklist to illustrate the typical tasks (we'll refine after kickoff).

Next step: if pricing looks OK, I'll route a formal quote to accounts@securetrust.com and propose kickoff windows (week of July 13 or July 20).

Regards,
Alex

[Attachment: securetrust-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf, 28 KB)]
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Greene <alex.greene@trustcenter.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Consolidation ask: TrustCenter via SecureTrust + SOW starter

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. Pricing is in the expected band. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Evidence matrix — attached is an internal slice of what we have (CSV export from our evidence collector). We'll convert to your preferred schema; Monica will lead that.
2) Controls mapping — we have a starting doc (internal) that maps our policy names to SOC2 CCs; I'll share read-only access to the team.

On timelines: July 13 kickoff works if accounts can process PO by July 9. Monica — can you aim to convert the attached evidence sheet into TrustCenter's sample by Friday? Markus — confirm the infra access items are staged (service account + read-only role).

Diego
